name: MythClash
detailed_description:
⚔️ MythClash – Fight for Your Legend!

MythClash is a fast-paced arena fighting game where legendary warriors inspired by global myths clash to protect their cultures and stories.

With stylized pixel art, dynamic combat, and a focus on local multiplayer fun, MythClash is built for intense showdowns with friends — and epic power plays blessed by ancient spirits.

🧭 What to Expect:

  • 8 playable characters, each representing a different continent and guided by mythical entities drawn from their regional folklore.

    (And there are whispers of an eighth warrior, hailing from a place that appears on no map...)

  • Unique special abilities, granted by the legendary beings that bless each fighter — turning the tide of battle in unexpected ways.

  • Themed arenas with multiple layouts, interactive elements, and environmental hazards.

  • Multiple game modes, including Stock Battle (one-hit KOs) and Stamina Battle (health bars and customizable rounds).

  • Combat items and unpredictable twists, adding chaos and strategy to every match.

  • 2–4 player local multiplayer, with future support for online play via Parsec and Steam Remote Play.

  • Single-player and bot support planned for future updates.

🛠️ Development Status

MythClash is currently in active development and does not yet have a demo on Steam.
We’re running early playtests on external platforms as we expand the game’s systems, content, and characters.

📌 Wishlist MythClash now to follow development, join future tests, and get notified of key updates!

🚀 Ready to fight for your culture, your legend, and your victory?

The tournament is just beginning...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core CPU, 2.0 GHz or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU (integrated graphics supported)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 400 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A gamepad or keyboard supporting multiple simultaneous inputs is recommended for local multiplayer.
